acceptance_predicates.description: ASB and TUI agree on omitted dev, explicit channels, restart, upgrade, rollback, remove, malformed manifest, and unavailable channel cases.
Typed diagnostics and human/--json semantics are identical at the paired boundary.
Development-only credential and authenticity warnings do not block the matrix.

definition_of_done: A disposable paired runner records exact heads and manifest digests.
Independent review accepts the complete matrix receipt.

inputs.description: Exact ASB/TUI heads and channel fixtures.

gates.description: The same channel cases produce compatible typed outcomes in both products.
